observations: Photo 0 and photo 1: a white computerized sewing machine with a blue floral side panel and a colour LCD screen, sitting on a bed.
Photo 0 and photo 1: 'brother' printed on the front of the arm.
Photo 1: a small model code above the screen on the blue panel begins 'SE6', last digits too blurry to read with certainty.
Photo 0 and photo 1: an embroidery unit is attached to the free arm on the left, so this is a combination sewing and embroidery machine.
Photo 1: the LCD screen appears lit with a coloured image, suggesting the machine was powered at the time, but no stitching is shown.
No embroidery hoop, foot controller, power cord, accessory box or manual shown.
A 'ABIOLA MACHINE' watermark and 'posted on Jiji' mark are on both photos; both photos are the same angle, low resolution.
No close view of the needle area, bobbin case, or the underside.

identity.model: SE600 series (panel code starts 'SE6', seller says SE630)
read_from: photo 1 blue panel model code, partly legible

claims.evidence: 'brother' is printed on the arm in photo 0 and photo 1.
Photo 1 shows a code beginning 'SE6' but the last digits are not legible; the blue floral panel and embroidery unit fit the SE600 series.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show a colour LCD and an attached embroidery unit.

risks.risk: Machine does not sew or embroider correctly (motor, timing, embroidery arm movement, touchscreen response).
risks.proof: Clip of the machine sewing a straight stitch and then running a short embroidery design in the hoop, screen being touched.

risks.risk: Embroidery hoop, foot controller, power cord and presser feet missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out next to the machine.
risks.if_unproven: as machine and embroidery unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Exact model is a cheaper variant of the SE600 series.
risks.proof: Close sharp photo of the model label on the panel or the rating plate on the back or underside.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest priced model of the series

risks.risk: Cracked screen, broken parts or heavy wear hidden by the low resolution and single angle.
risks.proof: Sharp photos of the screen, the needle area and the back of the machine.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine sewing a straight stitch and running an embroidery design.
Sharp close photo of the model label or rating plate.
Photo of all accessories: hoop, foot controller, power cord, presser feet.
Sharp photos of the screen and needle area.
response.reason: The machine is a Brother computerized sewing and embroidery machine read from both photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working and without accessories; the exact SE630 model is only partly legible and a running clip and model plate would raise the price.
